 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Accessbility"** is misspelt. The correct spelling should be "Accessibility". (सुगमता)

 
 
• **Example: **Ensuring web accessibility is essential for providing a good user experience for everyone.
 
 
 
• **"Accessibility"** means the quality of being easy to obtain or use. (सुगमता)
 
 
• **Example: **The accessibility of public transportation is crucial for people with disabilities.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 1**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Aptitude** (क्षमता): A natural ability to do something.

 
 
• **Example:** She has a remarkable aptitude for learning new languages.
 
 
 
• **Apparatus** (उपकरण): The technical equipment or machinery needed for a particular activity or purpose.
 
 
• **Example: **The laboratory is equipped with modern scientific apparatus.
 
 
 
• **Atrocious** (भयंकर): Horrifyingly wicked.
 
 
• **Example:** The crimes committed during the war were absolutely atrocious.
